name: claude-code-auth-flow
title: Claude Code authentication
description: Authenticate Claude Code CLI via OAuth with Google sign-in
preconditions: Verify comet-cdp is up (port 9222) — run: comet-cdp status
Verify the CLI tool is installed and available in PATH
Run: <cli> auth login — it prints an OAuth URL and waits for the callback
Check the app is signed in — open claude.ai and verify it's not on /login. If logged out, sign in manually first.

vars.name: auth_url
vars.description: The OAuth URL printed by the CLI (platform.claude.com/oauth/authorize?...)

vars.name: google_account
vars.description: Google account to select. Pass the full email; the --account shortcut also works.

steps.rationale: Open the Claude OAuth authorization URL from the CLI in Comet
steps.on_failure: If redirected to claude.ai/login?reauth=1, the Comet session has expired — sign in to claude.ai manually in Comet first, then retry from step 1

steps.rationale: Capture the page state — check if already authenticated (redirects to consent) or shows login page
Claude session is logged out — need to sign in via Google
steps.condition: URL contains '/login' or page shows 'Log in' heading

then.rationale: Find the Continue with Google button
Initiate Google OAuth flow — this opens a NEW TAB for the Google account picker
Switch to the Google account picker tab that just opened
See the list of Google accounts — some may be missing or marked 'Signed out'
Account is in the picker — click it directly
then.condition: the desired account {{google_account}} is visible in the list

then.rationale: Select the correct Google account

otherwise.rationale: Account not in the picker — sign in with email directly
Find the email input field on the sign-in page
Need to enter password — the account was signed out

then.rationale: Hand off to the user — this flow has no password and must not guess one. Ask them to type it into the browser window and submit it themselves, then continue. Do NOT fill the field and do NOT press Enter: a fill with no value types an empty password, and the Enter after it submits one, spending a failed login attempt on the user's account.
Re-read the page after the hand-off: the steps below click Google's 'Continue' or Claude's 'Authorize', and both are only on the right page once a password was actually submitted

The password field is still on screen, so the user has not submitted one — a slow hand-off, not a failed login. Continue and the next click lands on the wrong page and the flow still exits 0. Stop here instead. This is the one way the executor has to end a run: a step whose target does not resolve returns an error, and an error fails the flow.

Deliberate hard failure, not a selector to repair: `pixel-flow-assert-password-not-submitted` is a sentinel no page contains, so resolving it errors and the run stops with a failed status instead of continuing signed out.
Check for Google consent screen — 'You're signing back in to Claude'
Google asks for consent to share your account info with Claude
then.condition: page shows 'Continue' button or 'signing back in' text

then.rationale: Approve Google consent — the Google tab will close and redirect back to Claude
Switch back to the Claude tab — Google auth completed and redirected back
Check if captcha or consent screen appeared on the Claude side
hCaptcha blocks automated clicks — reload the page to clear it
then.condition: page contains 'hCaptcha' or 'Drag' or 'Skip Challenge' or captcha iframe

then.rationale: Reload the page to clear hCaptcha — it often doesn't reappear after reload
Wait for page to reload
Re-check after reload — captcha should be gone

steps.rationale: Check for the Claude OAuth consent/authorize screen
Claude OAuth may show a consent screen granting the CLI tool access to your account
steps.condition: page shows 'Authorize' or 'Allow' or 'Consent' or 'Continue' button for CLI access

then.rationale: Scroll down to enable the Authorize button (it's disabled until scrolled into view)
Brief wait for the button state to update
Re-snapshot after scroll — Authorize button should now be enabled
Approve the OAuth request for Claude Code CLI
then.on_failure: If click doesn't navigate, reload the page (location.reload()) and retry — hCaptcha may have blocked the click

steps.rationale: Verify the callback — URL should contain platform.claude.com/oauth/code/callback?code=...
The callback has the auth code — the CLI should pick it up automatically

then.rationale: Wait for the CLI to exchange the code and confirm authentication

success_signal: CLI prints 'Successfully authenticated' or callback URL contains code parameter
